subject: Encord & [COMPANY] - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the recent raise! I wanted to reach out since we recently
started working with one of your notable AI Fleet Safety peers on
developing very similar driver behaviour and road monitoring computer
vision models with the goal of migrating them away from legacy in-house
infrastructure that was acting as a bottleneck for new product releases.

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while
keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data
mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos
natively on our platform.

Bit of context on Encord...we're an SF-based computer vision scale-up
(recently raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation,
annotation, workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

We've been following [COMPANY] for a while now and would love to get your
candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord if you have 15 mins
to chat. Would you be open to a quick call with our leadership team next
week? Wednesdays / Thursdays work best on our end, however we're very happy
to work around your schedule.
